items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 232:1
items.html: The head of Beriah is the secret of the HGT of AA, where the NHY of Atik clothe, and likewise the point of the Malchut of Atzilut descended there and clothed in these HGT of AA, and became the head of the foxes. (Item 233).
